title: A string toolkit
description:
Write helpers with the string library.

```
trim("  hi  ")          -> "hi"
title("ada lovelace")    -> "Ada Lovelace"
starts("filename.lua", "file") -> true
ends("filename.lua", ".lua")   -> true
```

starter.main.lua:
local function trim(s)
  return s
end

local function title(s)
  return s
end

print("[" .. trim("  hi  ") .. "]")

hints: `s:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix` checks the start as plain text, without patterns.
requirements: `starts` and `ends` must not treat `.` or `%` specially (they are plain text).
stretch: Write `split(s, sep)` that also works when `sep` is a pattern character like `.`.
